title: Bluetooth protocol library
body: I would like to extract the Bluetooth protocol for communicating with the Dexcom G6 into a separate library (I'm looking at pycom's Gpy using python, but really this might be useful for other things). I think it's mostly implemented in /app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/Services/G5CollectionService.java, however this file is pretty complex given all the Android code for bluetooth. Can anyone point me to a protocol definition for talking to the G6 (I know there's nothing official) or was it simply coded directly in Java?
